_note: E10.2 — the ingestion pipeline's expected handling of each damaged file. 'status' is what _process() classifies it as (unrecognised | rejected | ok). 'rows_loaded' is what reaches SQL. 'must_say' are substrings that must appear (case-insensitive) in the rendered data-quality report. E1.4: never a silent partial load — every file is either not loaded (unrecognised/rejected) or loaded with the gap named.

01_unrecognised_firewall_export.csv.failure_mode: headers match no source profile (a firewall rule export, not an inventory)

03_servers_header_only.csv.failure_mode: valid servers header, no data rows

04_performance_no_dates.csv.failure_mode: performance export missing the required sample_date column

05_servers_ragged_rows.csv.failure_mode: inconsistent field counts — short rows lose OS/app, long rows have trailing junk

06_servers_garbage_numerics.csv.failure_mode: non-numeric values in vcpu / ram_gb ('N/A', 'eight', '16 GB')

07_servers_duplicate_ids.csv.failure_mode: the same server_id on three rows with different specs

08_servers_utf16.csv.failure_mode: UTF-16 encoding — the reader expects UTF-8, headers decode to nonsense

09_dependencies_orphan_endpoints.csv.failure_mode: every dependency endpoint references a server not in any uploaded file
must_say: dependency endpoints are not known servers
